source.title: Salamander Grand Piano V3 (48 kHz / 24-bit FLAC edition)
source.author: Alexander Holm
source.recordingContext: Two AKG C414 microphones in AB position about 12 cm above the strings; analyzed edition is 48 kHz / 24-bit FLAC.
source.localSfzHeader: The analyzed mapping is the 48 kHz / 24-bit FLAC Salamander Grand Piano V3 distribution from the canonical submodule.

mapping.sampledPitchSpacing: minor thirds from A0 through C8
mapping.sustainGroup: 16 mapped velocity layers with per-note offsets and dedicated undamped high-note release settings
mapping.additionalLayers: chromatic release noises, three string-resonance release strengths, and two pedal-down/two pedal-up recordings

source.redistribution: Reference audio stays in the external submodule; only scalar measurements are retained in reports.

preprocessing.waveform: Decode the native reference format without resampling; normalize signed PCM by its bit depth; arithmetic stereo mid is used for waveform peak/RMS/onset.
preprocessing.spectral: Analyze L/R separately with a Hann window, average power spectra to avoid AB-microphone phase cancellation, and ignore energy above 16 kHz for centroid.
preprocessing.onset: Causal 3 ms sliding RMS (no future samples at the buffer boundary); first crossing at 4% of the first-250-ms maximum; spectral window begins 25 ms after that crossing.
preprocessing.pitch: Find and report the recorded local spectral maximum near equal-tempered pitch without retuning or transposition.
preprocessing.decay: Fit dB/second to Hann-windowed partial peaks on microphone channel 1 at fixed post-onset times; T60=-60/slope. This is a proxy and is sensitive to beating/noise floors.
preprocessing.focusedTransient: A6v16 uses onset-aligned 0-5/5-10/10-20/20-40/40-80 ms frames on the arithmetic stereo mid, a fixed 50 ms RMS trajectory, and a 1.5 s L/R power-averaged FFT for the unison cluster.
